description: Create the shared design system in a new `ARC FINAL DEPLOYMENT/theme.css` (the file every page links via href="theme.css" but which does not exist, so those links currently 404). This file establishes ONE coherent industrial/environmental design language: CSS custom-property design tokens (muted palette: deep forest, eucalyptus, olive/verdigris, graphite, warm off-white, amber warning; NOT bright #22c55e/#4ade80 eco-green and NOT the energy.html near-black neon-green terminal look), typography scale (Inter for text, JetBrains Mono for numeric readouts), spacing scale, restrained borders over heavy shadows, and the SHARED SHELL + reusable component classes used across pages: .sidebar / .sidebar-brand / .logo-mark / .logo-inner / .brand-text / .sidebar-nav / .nav-item / .nav-icon / .nav-label / .sidebar-footer and .bottom-nav (plus the .topbar structure dashboard uses). This resolves the missing-theme.css inconsistency by option (a): a single shared shell so dashboard/control (which reference .sidebar with no backing CSS today) and auditlog/energy/settings (which each define .sidebar inline today) all render the SAME shell. This is foundation-only: do not yet edit the individual pages' bodies in this feature beyond what is needed to confirm the shell renders. No new external dependencies (reuse Inter + JetBrains Mono + Tabler icons + vendored Chart.js already loaded by the pages).
steps: Create `ARC FINAL DEPLOYMENT/theme.css`. Define :root design tokens: color palette (e.g. --bg warm off-white, --surface, --surface-soft, --border subtle, --ink graphite, --text-secondary, --text-muted, a muted forest/eucalyptus --accent and --accent-dim that are clearly NOT #22c55e/#4ade80, --warning amber, --danger, --ok/--live state colors), radius scale, spacing scale, shadow tokens (restrained), and typography tokens (font families, numeric mono family, weight/size steps for the big-value/small-unit/quiet-label pattern).

Define the shared left SIDEBAR shell matching the markup contract exactly: .sidebar, .sidebar-brand, .logo-mark + .logo-inner (CSS-only logo mark, no image), .brand-text, .sidebar-nav, .nav-item (with .active and clear touch-friendly >=44px hit targets and active state that does NOT rely on hover), .nav-icon, .nav-label, .sidebar-footer. Study the existing inline .sidebar definitions in auditlog.html / energy.html / settings.html (collapse-on-hover pattern) and the markup in dashboard.html / control.html to make the class names and structure line up. Account for the `.sidebar:hover ~ .main-content` content-offset pattern those pages rely on, OR a fixed-width shell — pick one approach and keep it consistent so content does not sit under the sidebar.
Define the mobile .bottom-nav shell (dashboard references it) with .nav-item/.ti/active states, hidden on desktop and shown under a small-screen breakpoint.

Define a shared .topbar region (dashboard uses .topbar/.topbar-titles/.topbar-actions/.topbar-search/.topbar-icon-btn/.topbar-avatar) with tokenized styling so the greeting/user/status area is consistent.

Define reusable, purposeful card/panel classes with visual VARIETY (not all identical rounded rectangles): a KPI/stat card, a monitoring/reading panel (big numeric value + small unit + quiet label using the mono font), a control panel, a trend/chart panel, and a status-row/unit-summary-row style. Include a clear, professional `.unconfirmed`/`.stale`/`Unavailable` visual treatment (amber, restrained, not neon) that other pages can reuse for the no-fake-data states.

Define responsive breakpoints so there is NO horizontal scroll at common 16:9 widths (e.g. 1920x1080, 1366x768) and controls stay touch-comfortable. Keep transitions minimal/functional only (no scroll animations, parallax, animated backgrounds).
Do NOT modify api.js, scheduler.js, or chart.umd.min.js. Do NOT yet rewrite page bodies here except trivial verification; later features consume this file.
acceptance_criteria: `ARC FINAL DEPLOYMENT/theme.css` exists and is valid CSS (no unclosed blocks).

theme.css defines every shared shell class named in the markup contract: .sidebar, .sidebar-brand, .logo-mark, .logo-inner, .brand-text, .sidebar-nav, .nav-item, .nav-icon, .nav-label, .sidebar-footer, .bottom-nav.
The palette contains NO #22c55e, #4ade80, #00ff00, or near-black neon-green terminal colors as primary accents; accents are muted environmental tones.
Tokens exist for typography (text + numeric mono), spacing, radius, borders, and state colors including a dedicated unconfirmed/unavailable treatment.
git diff shows api.js, scheduler.js, chart.umd.min.js unchanged.
verification: Run `node -e "const fs=require('fs');const c=fs.readFileSync('ARC FINAL DEPLOYMENT/theme.css','utf8');const o=(c.match(/{/g)||[]).length,cl=(c.match(/}/g)||[]).length;if(o!==cl)throw new Error('brace mismatch '+o+'/'+cl);console.log('theme.css braces balanced',o);"` from the app subfolder's parent (the repo root) and confirm balanced braces.
Grep theme.css for each required shell class name and confirm all are present.
Grep theme.css to confirm forbidden colors (#22c55e, #4ade80, #00ff00) are absent from accent/primary roles.
Run `git status` and confirm api.js, scheduler.js, chart.umd.min.js are not listed as modified.
findings:
Created `ARC FINAL DEPLOYMENT/theme.css` (foundation only; no page bodies rewritten). KEY FACTS FOR LATER FEATURES:
- LOAD ORDER: every page links theme.css AFTER its inline <style>, so theme.css WINS ties on equal specificity. This is intentional: it lets theme.css override the inline sidebar/palette definitions in auditlog/energy/settings and supply the missing shell to dashboard/control, so all pages render ONE consistent shell.
- SHELL MARKUP CONTRACT (identical across pages): <nav class="sidebar"> > .sidebar-brand > (.logo-mark > .logo-inner) + .brand-text; .sidebar-nav > a.nav-item > (.nav-icon.ti + .nav-label); optional .sidebar-footer (dashboard puts a <button class="nav-item" id="soundToggle"> there, with #soundDot as .nav-icon and #soundStatus as .nav-label). settings.html's .sidebar-brand has NO .logo-mark element (just .brand-text) — the CSS logo mark only renders where the markup includes it; that is fine.
- CONTENT OFFSET: chosen approach is a FIXED-footprint rail (68px) that expands to 224px on hover as an OVERLAY (does not push content). theme.css sets `body { padding-left: var(--arc-nav-width) }` so content never sits under the rail on ANY page regardless of each page's own inline layout. NOTE: settings/energy/auditlog also set `body padding-left: var(--nav-width)` inline, but theme.css loads later so its 68px wins (no double offset). Under 820px the rail hides and .bottom-nav shows; body padding-left:0 + padding-bottom for the bar.
- TOKENS are namespaced `--arc-*` to avoid clobbering each page's existing `--accent` etc. Component classes are namespaced `arc-` (.arc-panel, .arc-kpi, .arc-reading, .arc-control, .arc-chart, .arc-status-row, .arc-dot, .arc-badge, .arc-grid). The no-fake-data treatment is reusable as `.unconfirmed` / `.stale` / `.unavailable` on a value element, `.arc-unavailable` as an inline badge, and `.arc-empty` for empty panels — all restrained amber (--arc-warning #b7791f), never neon. control.html already applies `.unconfirmed` via its isLive()/markLiveness(); theme.css now styles it.
- PALETTE: accent is deep eucalyptus #3f6b52 (dim #2f5240, strong #244033), olive #6b7a4f, amber warning #b7791f, muted brick danger #a53a2f. Forbidden #22c55e/#4ade80/#00ff00 appear ONLY inside an explanatory comment, never as values.
- VERIFIED: braces balanced 113/113 (node one-liner); all 17 shell/topbar classes present; git status shows api.js/scheduler.js/chart.umd.min.js UNCHANGED (no diff). Committed on main (not pushed).
- NOT DONE (future features): page bodies still use their old inline styles/palettes and hardcoded/mock data; dashboard/control topbar+sidebar now have backing CSS but bodies not yet rewired. No browser render check was possible (no chromium on PATH); validation was static (CSS validity + class/colour greps).
